scenes.setting: Sird Street, an ironclad steam vehicle at the door: the Backlund Bike Company is carved up — Framis 47%, Leppard 43%, Klein 10% and 2,235 pounds — until Jurgen points out how strangely quickly he agreed, and Klein begins to suspect one of them nudged his mind
Inside the roaring steam vehicle: Framis confirms the lawyer's power triggered passively and warns him off using it in such situations — 'Do not let this affect what matters most.'

A cheap East Borough coffee shop: a pound in expenses and bonus, no progress from The Fool's hunters, strike organizers to watch quietly — and one name that stops the coffee halfway: gangsters and bounty hunters are searching for Azik Eggers, of Balam lineage, once a university lecturer
